Planning to buy a car is an exciting milestone! To make a ₹500,000 goal highly achievable, we need to break it down into a realistic timeline. 

Currently, our assessment shows this is a high-risk commitment without knowing your financial starting point. To turn this into an actionable plan, **could you share your preferred timeline (e.g., 12, 24, or 36 months) and your typical monthly net income?** 

Once we have that, we can calculate exactly how much you need to save each month and look at your budget to find easy ways to reach your goal faster!
